summary: Remove yawn_vps from the release contract and report the nightly rehearsal in backup-status.
details: Menhir commits 66aa7a6 and c995337 (with the digest refresh that follows them) complete the yawn.vps sever begun in release 0.2.0-16. New release records name three repositories (menhir, archolith_oauth, yawn_deploy); records up to 16, which pinned yawn_vps for provenance, remain valid as the legacy four-repository shape and are accepted as prior authorities. The only installed artifact whose bytes change is /srv/menhir/production/bin/backup-status, which now prints the nightly wrapper's rehearsal result, generation and downtime alongside the run record. Outside the release, the scaffold's daily audit now runs verify-artifacts (the retired gateway's ExecStartPre was the only unattended run of it) and the yawn user leaves the menhir-operators group, whose MENHIR_READ sudoers grant it only needed for that gateway. Images are inherited from release 0.2.0-13 unchanged.
operator_impact: Cutting a release no longer references yawn.vps at all. backup-status shows whether last night's backup was rehearsed. No runtime, ingress or secret change.
